description: Qualité de Service selon opérateurs - 2G, 3G, 4G - Juillet 2016 is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Données et rapports de l'enquête qualité de service mobile 2016 de l'Arcep. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are 2G, 3G, 4G, Orange, SFR, Bouygues. The portal shows 337 records. The portal shows 2018-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v1.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
